Name: Pelican Town Farm
Author: stardemod
Description:
[b]Pelican Town Farm[/b] is a custom map that looks exactly like Pelican Town – but it's actually your [b]farm[/b]!
All buildings have been removed, giving you a clean slate to build [b]your own rival town[/b] – better-looking and without Clint.

Adds a new farm map without overwriting any of the existing ones.

I haven’t figured out how to make the bushes destroyable. [b]If you know how to do this, I’d appreciate a message![/b]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Pelican Town Farm
Manifest.Description: A farm reminiscent of Pelican Town.
